tldr: A critical security flaw in the PHP programming language is posing a global cyber-security threat, affecting a large portion of the internet and causing government services to go offline.
Oil prices have surged to a five-month high due to escalating tensions in the Middle East, including reports of vessels being struck and potential U.S. strikes against Iran.
UN advisors warn that almost all shallow-water coral reefs worldwide are at risk of ecosystem collapse by 2075 due to global heating.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite both closed higher, with JPMorgan strategists indicating that recent hedge fund positioning has significantly lightened, suggesting limited further downside for stocks.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield rose slightly, influenced by broader market pressures such as France's mounting economic crisis, which pushed its 10-year government bond yield to a new 24-year high.

vix.why: The VIX closed lower, aligning with the market's upward trend and a strategist's view that the stock market's downside may be limited, typically correlating with reduced volatility.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate, as surveyed by Freddie Mac, remained unchanged in its latest weekly release. Mortgage rates generally track the 10-year Treasury yield, which saw a modest increase over recent days.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

tech.summary: A critical security flaw in the PHP programming language, which underpins a significant portion of the internet, has sparked global alarm, with governments and major tech companies like Google, OpenAI, and Amazon responding to potential cyber threats.
1Password has introduced a new feature that enables AI agents to sign into user accounts without directly accessing or seeing the passwords, enhancing security while facilitating bot-assisted tasks.

Tesla has commenced early production of its Optimus humanoid robot on its high-volume line in Fremont, California, though CEO Elon Musk acknowledged that further development is needed in areas such as its hands, safety, reliability, durability, and artificial intelligence.

world.summary: Oil prices surged to a five-month high after Iran's IRGC reported hitting multiple vessels in the northern Gulf and near the Strait of Hormuz, with reports also circulating of potential U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran, signaling escalating conflict that threatens global supply.

United Nations advisors have issued a stark warning that nearly all shallow-water coral reefs globally, across 80 countries, are projected to face ecosystem collapse by 2075 due to accelerating global heating, urging immediate action.

French President Emmanuel Macron has condemned what he termed 'seditious acts' by 'ultra-left' groups amid ongoing protests and stated his intention to ban certain demonstrations, reinforcing police presence to restore order.

In the UK, 32 government services went offline due to a critical security flaw in the PHP programming language, which is used by the majority of websites globally and allows hackers to change websites or extract personal data.

us.summary: The Supreme Court ruled that the Trump administration must continue providing gender-affirming care to inmates in federal prisons, upholding a pause on efforts to change the policy while litigation proceeds.
The FAA has granted approval for airlines to begin operating Boeing's 737 Max 10, clearing a major regulatory hurdle for the largest variant of the 737 Max jet that has faced significant delays.

The Chiricahua monument in southeastern Arizona, known as the Land of Standing-Up Rocks for its towering spires, has officially been designated as the 64th U.S. national park, with the legislation passing with bipartisan support.

science.summary: The first human case of the Shamonda virus, previously believed to be non-transferable to humans and typically affecting cattle, has been identified in a patient in France who died in early October, though officials state there is no current health risk to the public.

New human data is beginning to emerge that hints at the potential for psychedelics, such as psilocybin, to combat inflammation, which could open new avenues for treating neurodegenerative conditions like Parkinson's disease.
